tasks.request: Repair select_tasks(tasks, status=None, limit=2). Tasks are a list of well-formed dictionaries with integer id, string status, optional integer priority and arbitrary extra fields. Apply these operations in order: filter by exact status (status=None includes every status); deduplicate by id keeping the first eligible occurrence in input order, even if a later duplicate has higher priority; sort the remaining tasks by descending priority, treating a missing priority as zero and preserving input order among ties; return up to limit items. Preserve each retained task's fields and never mutate the input list or dictionaries, including nested data. Require limit to be a positive integer excluding booleans; otherwise raise ValueError, including when tasks is empty. Empty or unmatched input returns an empty list. Modify only selection.py and leave all tests unchanged.

Repair normalize_tags(tags). Require a list containing only strings or raise ValueError. Collapse whitespace using split/join, Unicode-casefold the labels, drop empty labels and deduplicate in first-occurrence order. Do not mutate the input even on errors. Modify only tags.py and leave all tests unchanged.

Repair retry_delay(attempt, base=1, cap=60). For positive integer base and cap, return min(cap, base * 2 ** (attempt - 1)). Require attempt to be a positive integer excluding booleans or raise ValueError. Avoid computing an unbounded exponent for very large attempts. Modify only retry.py and leave all tests unchanged.
